info.title: Chilli Plant Diseases Dataset
info.subtitle: Dataset with images of healthy and unhealthy chili leaves and plants.
info.description: This dataset is reconstructed using offline growth from the original dataset. This dataset consists of about 1K rgb images of healthy and diseased chili leaves and plants, which are classified into 7 different classes. The entire dataset is divided into training and validation sets, preserving the catalog structure. A new catalog containing 70 test images is then created for prediction purposes.
